summary: AMC Entertainment filed an 8-K announcing a registered direct offering of 95.25 million shares at $2.10 per share, raising ~$200M gross proceeds. The company will use net proceeds of ~$189M to redeem its $125.5M 6.125% Senior Subordinated Notes due 2027, with the balance for general corporate purposes. Roth Capital Partners acted as placement agent, receiving a 5.5% cash fee. The offering closes June 24, 2026, and AMC agreed to a 45-day lock-up on new equity issuances. This is a capital-return event via debt redemption funded by equity issuance; monitor the redemption mechanics and any impact on the company's leverage profile.
